name: Susquehanna campus (Berwick)
locality: Salem Township near Berwick (Susquehanna nuclear plant)
status_note: Former Talen/Cumulus campus bought by AWS for $650M (Mar 2024) next to the Susquehanna nuclear plant; Buildings 1–3 online by Aug 2026 (~108 MW IT), Building 4 in 2027 (~169 MW) (Epoch); PA PUC filing describes 16 buildings.

construction_start.note: Talen: site-prep permits obtained and site work under way (Jul 2021).
